zobel.seenFailed: The read receipt could not be sent.
zobel.manualReadReceipts: Mark chats as read by hand
zobel.manualReadReceiptsHint: Opening a chat no longer marks it as read. A “Seen” button appears below the messages, and the read receipt is only sent once you tap it.
zobel.manualReadReceiptsTerms: Seen button, read receipts, read marker, manual, confirm
zobel.roomReadReceiptsHint: With this on, this chat is only marked as read once you tap “Seen” below the messages. Only for you. Reaches your other devices when “Sync settings across devices” is on.
zobel.focusComposerOnOpen: Jump to the message field when opening a chat
zobel.focusComposerOnOpenHint: On a touch screen this also opens the keyboard. “Automatic” only does it where the main input is a mouse or touchpad, not a touch screen.
zobel.focusComposerOnOpenTerms: keyboard, focus, composer, message field, open chat, autofocus
zobel.chatLookHint: Arranges chats and messages like Signal or Beeper.
zobel.chatLookTerms: layout, design, Signal, Beeper, WhatsApp, Discord, messenger, bubbles, chat list
